modules.title: Users, Rosters and Schedules
modules.content:
## Managing Users

As the Team Admin, you have access and responsibility to handle your team's Synergy accounts.  You can add new users, send password resets, reactivate or deactivate existing users, and even email from the Users Tab.

###

### Users Tab

Select the **Users** tab from the Team Site to access all of the users for your team's subscription.

![Screenshot: Managing Users](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000573006-01.jpg)

Once the Users Tab is open, on the left of the screen there is a menu that allows you to filter by user status, user type, and name or expiration date.

####

![Screenshot: Managing Users](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000573006-02.jpg)

####

####

#### Add Users

To add a new user, select **+Add**.

![Screenshot: Managing Users](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000573006-03.jpg)

After selecting +Add you can create Staff and Player accounts. You can enter the Name, Title, E-Mail, and Phone Number of the new User. If you are adding a Staff member who you wish to have administrator access to your Synergy account, toggle the Administrator button to Yes.

![Screenshot: Managing Users](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000573006-04.jpg)

Once all fields have been filled, select Add User, and the account will be created and a welcome email will be automatically generated with instructions for the user on how to set up their password for their Synergy account.

![Screenshot: Managing Users](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000573006-05.jpg)

#### Manage Users

To send password resets, reactivate or deactivate accounts, or send emails, you must first select the users you wish to manage. You can select users by marking the checkboxes in the upper right of the user squares.

![Screenshot: Managing Users](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000573006-06.jpg)

Once the users have been selected, the send password reset, reactivate users, deactivate users, and email users options will become available.

![Screenshot: Managing Users](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000573006-07.jpg)

If you experience any issues or difficulties with your user management, please reach out to our Support Team at [support@synergysports.com](mailto:support@synergysports.com) or call 1-800-411-1627.

## Roster & Schedule Management

As part of season prep, users will need to send team rosters and schedules. Directions for sending rosters and schedules can be found below.

### **Rosters**

Once your roster is finalized, fill in the Roster tab of [**THIS FORM**](https://files.constantcontact.com/d860742b301/e0e70f1e-6ec4-4886-9408-3a62fc2477c1.xlsx?_gl=1*1r00jjj*_ga*ZDJkNWVkNmYtNTZiZi00ZjZkLTk3ZjgtNDMzYmQ4NjAwZDYz*_ga_14T5LGLSQ3*MTcyNTY0MTM0Mi41LjEuMTcyNTY0MzQ5MS4zNy4wLjA.) (the file will go to your downloads when you click). Completed roster spreadsheets should be sent via email to [synergy-support@sportradar.com](mailto:synergy-support@sportradar.com).

- Make sure the green column headers of the form are filled out for each player.
- If your roster changes during the season, email [**synergy-support@sportradar.com**](mailto:synergy-support@sportradar.com) with the changes.
- Rosters are used to log games. Users will still be responsible for creating player Synergy accounts (see the “Users, Rosters and Schedules” lesson).

**Schedules**

If your MAXPREPS schedule for the upcoming season is accurate, then you are set. If not, you can either update it on MAXPREPS as soon as possible or you can add your schedule to the Schedule tab of [**THIS FORM**](https://files.constantcontact.com/d860742b301/e0e70f1e-6ec4-4886-9408-3a62fc2477c1.xlsx?_gl=1*1r00jjj*_ga*ZDJkNWVkNmYtNTZiZi00ZjZkLTk3ZjgtNDMzYmQ4NjAwZDYz*_ga_14T5LGLSQ3*MTcyNTY0MTM0Mi41LjEuMTcyNTY0MzQ5MS4zNy4wLjA.). Completed schedule spreadsheets should be sent to [synergy-support@sportradar.com](mailto:synergy-support@sportradar.com).

- If your schedule changes during the season, email [**synergy-support@sportradar.com**](mailto:synergy-support@sportradar.com) with the changes.
- If a game is missing from your schedule when you go to upload it to Synergy via Video Express (see the “Uploading, Logging and Sharing Games” lesson), contact support to make the addition.
- Check your schedule in Video Express (see the “Installing Video Express” lesson in Synergy Video Express for Basketball) prior to game day to ensure quicker turnaround times for your breakdowns.

***** Completed schedule and roster spreadsheets should be sent to***[**synergy-support@sportradar.com**](mailto:synergy-support@sportradar.com)***.***

## Reviewing Upload Schedules

The **Upload Schedule** feature shows the status of uploaded games, and it details which games a team is required to upload. The Upload Schedule also provides information on the competition categories and any additional comments that are associated with the upload.

### Navigating the Upload Schedule

To get started, click on the **Game** tab. Then click on the **Upload Schedule** tab.

![Screenshot: Reviewing Upload Schedules](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000573007-01.jpg)

Use the**Games Filters** on the left to narrow down teams, and then select a team from the **Team A** dropdown.

![Screenshot: Reviewing Upload Schedules](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000573007-02.jpg)

Once the **Games Filters** have been applied and you have selected a team from the **Team A** dropdown, that team's upload schedule will appear. The upload schedule will have the most recent game listed at the top.

![Screenshot: Reviewing Upload Schedules](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000573007-03.jpg)

The Upload Schedule tab includes functionality that provides information on:

- **Game Date**
- **Game**: Includes the names of the teams playing in the game
- **Type**: Whether the game footage will be pulled from TV or requires an upload by a team participating in the game.
- **Status**: *Not Available*, *Complete*, *P1*, *P2*, *Future* (Coming Soon)
  - Not Available: The game has not been uploaded yet or is a game that is in the future
  - P1: The game is in the Phase I Logged stage. This is the first step of the logging process and means Full Game Video is available for download in Video Express.
  - P2: The game is in the Phase 2 Logged stage.  This is the second step of the logging process and means all logging and breakdowns have been completed. All videos and stats are available for this game.
  - Complete: The game has been fully logged, and all statistics are associated with the video.
  - Future (Coming Soon): This means a game slot has not been created for this game as it is likely far in the future.  Once the game date nears, a game slow will be created for the game and can be used for upload.
- **Competition**: The type of game being played.  Typically, this column will detail whether it's an exhibition, regular season, or playoff game.
- **Comments**: This is where comments can be entered that detail context about the video uploaded or if there's an issue with the upload.

As an added feature, clicking on **Complete**in the status column will redirect you to that game's breakdown.

![Screenshot: Reviewing Upload Schedules](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000573007-04.jpg)

You can also click on a team name in the **Game** column to display that team's upload schedule.

![Screenshot: Reviewing Upload Schedules](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000573007-05.jpg)

modules.title: Uploading, Logging and Sharing Games
modules.content:
## Game Upload Instructions

High School teams will need to upload a [roster template](https://support-materials.synergysportstech.com/High_School_Roster_Template.xlsx) and game video for every game. Here are a few things to note when completing these tasks in Video Express:

- Opponent rosters need to be uploaded for every game.
- Home rosters only need to be uploaded once, at the beginning of the season, unless there are roster changes throughout the season.
- Synergy cannot log games correctly if home rosters and opponent rosters are not accurate.
- Home rosters and opponent rosters can be added to the same Roster Template (i.e. you only need to complete one roster template for both teams).

Below are step-by-step instructions for uploading roster templates and game videos in Video Express.

#### [** Video Express can be downloaded here **](https://www.synergysportstech.com/apps/videoexpress/)

####

#### Uploading a Roster Template

After you log in to Video Express, click the**Start Upload** button.

![Screenshot: Game Upload Instructions](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570451-01.jpg)

Then click the **Roster** button.

![Screenshot: Game Upload Instructions](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570451-02.jpg)

Use the filters to find the game you are uploading. Then click on the game and select **Upload**.

![Screenshot: Game Upload Instructions](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570451-03.jpg)

After you click the Upload button, you will be redirected to a set of Video Express instructions and resources. Read the information and then click **Continue**.

![Screenshot: Game Upload Instructions](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570451-04.jpg)

You will then be prompted to upload your roster template. Select your file and then click **Open**.

![Screenshot: Game Upload Instructions](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570451-05.jpg)

You will then be taken to the Upload/Download page, where you can monitor the upload progress. After your roster template is uploaded, start a **New Upload** for your game video.

![Screenshot: Game Upload Instructions](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570451-06.jpg)

####

#### Uploading Game Video

After you have completed the steps for uploading a roster template, click on **New Game Upload**.

![Screenshot: Game Upload Instructions](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570451-07.jpg)

Use the filters to find the game you are uploading. Then click on the game and select **Upload**.

![Screenshot: Game Upload Instructions](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570451-08.jpg)

After you click the Upload button, you will be redirected to Video Express Reminders and then Video Express Instructions. Read the information on these pages, and then click **Continue**.

> Note: You can select **Do not show this message again**in the bottom, left corner.

![Screenshot: Game Upload Instructions](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570451-09.jpg)

Next, you will be prompted to upload your video. Select your file and click **Open**.

![Screenshot: Game Upload Instructions](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570451-10.jpg)

Then you will be asked to provide the final score, jersey colors, and game structure, as well as acknowledge that you have already uploaded a roster template. Then you can click **Continue**.

![Screenshot: Game Upload Instructions](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570451-11.jpg)

Once your video has completely uploaded, you will have successfully finished your Video Express tasks.

![Screenshot: Game Upload Instructions](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000570451-12.jpg)

## Game Logging Checklist

To ensure games are logged promptly, Synergy relies on coaches and administrators to supply specific information. Please use the checklist and the guidelines below to make sure all necessary details have been provided for accurate game logging.

[** Roster Templates can be downloaded here **](https://support-materials.synergysportstech.com/High_School_Roster_Template.xlsx)

[** Video Express can be downloaded here **](https://www.synergysportstech.com/apps/videoexpress/)

![Screenshot: Game Logging Checklist](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585465-01.jpg)

**Team Rosters**

- This is only required once unless there are changes to the team and jersey numbers.
- First name, last name, and jersey numbers required.

**Opponent Rosters**

- This is required every game, and matches will not be logged without an opponent roster.
- First name, last name, and jersey numbers are required.

**Accepted Film Formats**

- vob
- mp4
- avi
- wmv
- mov
- m4v
- mpg
- mod
- mts

**Clear Film and Jersey Numbers**

- Games cannot be logged if the film is too low in quality or missing large blocks of time.

****24-Hour Logging Window****

- Most games are completed within a 24-hour window if nothing is missing and the film is clear.
- The 24-hour window starts after a game has been completely uploaded.

## Non-Customer Video Sharing (High School Only)

### Non-Customer Video Sharing

#####

##### 1. Log into [Team Site](https://apps.synergysports.com/basketball) and click on the**Games** tab at the top of the page.

![Screenshot: Non-Customer Video Sharing (High School Only)](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565962-01.jpg)

##### 2. Apply the **Games Filters** on the left of the screen. The **League** must be set to High School.

![Screenshot: Non-Customer Video Sharing (High School Only)](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565962-02.jpg)

##### 3. Click on the game you wish to share.

![Screenshot: Non-Customer Video Sharing (High School Only)](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565962-03.jpg)

##### 4. When you get to the Game Data page, click **Send Full Game Video**.

![Screenshot: Non-Customer Video Sharing (High School Only)](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565962-04.jpg)

##### 5. Fill out the information for the recipient, and then click OK to share the video.

![Screenshot: Non-Customer Video Sharing (High School Only)](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565962-05.jpg)
